h1: Community replies in your brand voice
overview: People who comment or message are your warmest audience, and they notice when no one answers. We spend one week replying for you in your own accounts, in your voice, using a style guide we agree first. We answer questions, thank people, hide spam where the platform allows and flag anything that needs you, such as complaints. You get a saved reply library so your team can keep it going.

faq: Do you reply as if you were the business?
Yes, as your team, in your approved voice, with a signature or first name if you want. We never pretend to be a customer, and we do not post fake comments or reviews.
What happens with complaints or refunds?
We acknowledge them politely, then flag them to you in the same day. We do not offer refunds or make promises about orders unless you give us a rule for it.
Does this need access to my direct messages?
Yes, through the platform's own inbox access that you grant to us. We do not ask for passwords, and we do not copy private messages outside your accounts.
It is a one-week sprint with a library to keep going. Daily or monthly management is quoted separately, so ask for a written quote if you want it long term.
